I believe your example falls within the wider milestone aimed at providing / improving in-app notifications. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/8831

TB have noted that improving notifications is a priority and an area of active development. https://roadmaps.thunderbird.net/en-US/android/

I see you have also raised your point on Github. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/11300

You can keep an eye on the release notes as and when these changes make their way to beta/stable releases.

Feel free to raise any improvement suggestions you have on Mozilla Connect where community members can vote on them. Thunderbird takes these into consideration when reviewing their roadmap.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/idb-p/ideas/label-name/thunderbird%20android

If your reaching out for guidance/support to setup your primary account, please provide greater detail so the community can assist you.

Who is your email provider? Where in the setup process are you having difficulty? What error messages if any are displayed?
